BLOGS STACK EXCHANGE SOCIAL ENGAGEMENT

I’m thrilled to share my impactful contributions to the vibrant community throughout 2025. This year, I’ve actively engaged with the community, sharing insights, learning alongside others, and building on the invaluable support from fellow members. Being part of this journey has been both rewarding and inspiring.

In this post, I’ll capture the highlights of my 2025 contributions to the community. Engaging with the Sitecore family brings me great joy, and I’m honoured to be part of this dynamic network. Let’s delve into the highlights of my contributions throughout the year 2025.

Highlights: A Snapshot of My 2025 Contributions

Experienced Technical Blogger

Authored more than 12 in-depth blogs on advanced topics such as Sitecore XP, XM Cloud, content hub, Content SDK and Sitecore search, establishing a strong technical footprint.

Expanding Influence on LinkedIn

I now have 1,861 followers, reflecting a 35.9% growth over the previous 365 days. My content generated 20,468 impressions, marking a 457.6% increase, and reached 4,562 unique members across the Sitecore and digital experience community.

Supporting Developers on Sitecore Stack Exchange

Actively contributed to resolving community challenges, earning 300+ reputation points this year and solidifying my role as a trusted technical advisor.

TECHNICAL BLOG POSTS

Throughout the current year, I authored move than 12 technical blogs, delving into diverse topics. These encompass subjects like Sitecore XP, XM Cloud, Sitecore Personalize, Sitecore search, GQL and more. Here is the comprehensive list:

A key highlight was sharing insights on the latest advancements, such as the release of Sitecore AI, Personalization with Sitecore AI, Sitecore Stream, and various Practice Exams. The community response was overwhelmingly positive, underscoring the content’s value and impact. My blog website, dedicated to Sitecore and related technologies, has seen significant engagement this year with 24,602 views as of November 2025. The content has been well-received.

Website Link – https://insightswithpawantyagi.blogspot.com/

SITECORE STACK EXCHANGE

In 2025, I strengthened my presence on Sitecore Stack Exchange as an active contributor focused on solving real implementation challenges across XM Cloud, Next.js JSS, GraphQL, Experience Edge, Sitecore Search, and SPE automation. 

With 349 reputation, 7 answers, 2 questions, and participation over 3 years and 9 months, I have reached more than 4,000 developers and consistently shared practical, hands-on solutions that help teams troubleshoot faster and build more confidently.

This year, I ranked #2 for the quarter, reflecting steady growth and strong engagement. 

My answers span diverse topics—from webhooks timing out in XM Cloud to SPE scripts, 404 handling, pagination, and faceted search with Edge GraphQL. 

I also maintain an active blogging platform and LinkedIn presence, ensuring that the knowledge I share reaches the broader Sitecore community.

Profile: https://stackexchange.com/leagues/664/year/sitecore
